prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless tileable 3D game exterior ceramic wall ALBEDO texture, square 1024x1024. Create a neutral near-white small rectangular ceramic facing tile texture, inspired only by the material category visible in the attached campus photos (reference only; do not reproduce buildings or photos). Exactly 4 columns and 8 rows of horizontally elongated tiles, aligned stack bond, each tile twice as wide as tall. Perfect orthographic front view, full-bleed edge-to-edge repeat with continuous narrow cool-gray grout lines, including matching half-width grout at opposing outer edges. Clean lightly aged exterior glazed ceramic with subtle fine grain, very restrained individual tile tone variation, no cracks or damage. Near-white neutral color so the game can tint it pale yellow or ivory. Flat diffuse lighting, no directional shadows, no reflections, no vignette, no gradients, no perspective. No windows, buildings, objects, vegetation, text or watermark. One material swatch only, not a collage, not a rendered sphere. Seamless left/right and top/bottom.
